name: Standard (3-player)
description: The default 3-player game: light, dark and the Dragon, who plays the five Coast pieces. The Dragon Heads move up to 3 squares and the Tail up to 8. The King moves one square. Each Coast piece's first way off the Coast is through A5, and on the Coast a Dragon piece attacks only the Coast. The Dragon loses only when the Sun, the Moon and both Dragon Heads are captured and the Tail is checkmated. Bot self-play found the three seats close to even.
